name: MXL Switcher Core
description: Deterministic Program and Preview routing for MXL video flows. Processing, audio, monitoring, control surfaces, and encoded destinations remain separate media functions.
notes: Integration contract for a locally built image. The mounted config must use /mxl-domain, provide output definition files available inside the image, and bind the control listener to 0.0.0.0 when publishing port 18085. Keep the control API on a trusted network or behind an authenticated TLS reverse proxy.
